texts.preamble: Ram Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 23 September, 2019 Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Court No. - 13 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 465 of 2007 Revisionist :- Ram Prasad Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- Sarvajeet Dubey,Vishun Narain Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J. 1. The present revision is directed against the judgement and order dated 15.05.2007 passed by the Additional
texts.facts: The facts of the case are that on 24.02.7983 at around 10.15 A.M. the Food Inspector had found the revisionist selling milk. The Food Inspector took sample of the milk from the revisionist and after issuing notice on Form No.6 and purchased it by paying the milk amount. He prepared three samples as required and sent it for Public Analyst for examination. The Public Analyst in his report found that there was deficiency of fat about 13% from the normal one. Aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment, revisionist preferred appeal, which too was dismissed vide impugned judgement and order. 4. The incident is of the year 1986. 33 years gone by since the samples were taken. The trial court judgment is dated 15.05.2007.
texts.arguments: 5. Considering the fact that the incident had happened 33 years before and also considering the judgement of the Supreme Court rendered in the case of Nand Lal v. State of Uttarakhand and others, 2010 (4) SCC 562, in which the Supreme Court after considering the age of the appellant in that case and taking into account the fact that the incident was very old, reduced the sentence to the period already undergone, interest of justice would meet if upholding the conviction, but reduce the sentence to the period already undergone with some fine.
